mo_ta_cong_viec:
Executionlab is a software development company based in Ho Chi Minh City that works on digital transformation projects for many clients mainly from Japan. 
We are looking for a Fresher BrSE to join our team. If you're an experienced IT-comtor, who is willing to take on the BrSE career path, you're welcome to apply.
 
Job Description
Interact directly with clients in Japan to negotiate and receive project activities.
Join as a bridge for meetings between the project team and client. Create documents related to project development.
Help the development team create documents to report, and track the relationship between the customer and the development team.
Support Project Manager’s or Leader's tasks.
Improve Project management skills to become BrSE (if you are an ITComtor) or Bridge Project Manager (BPM) in the future.
yeu_cau:
MUST HAVE
Have Japanese N2 level or higher 
Good communication skills, can hold a conversation with Japanese clients in a business manner.
NICE TO HAVE
Any experience at Japanese IT companies (software/game/product)
Previous experience working on-site in Japan 
Good logical thinking, good self-management skills.
Ability to multitask,  to work under high pressure, to work in teams and work independently
Background as a software engineer (in any position) is preferable.
JAPANESE CV OR 履歴書 IS REQUIRED
